facts.fact: The UN E-Government Survey 2024 says the UN Economic Commission for Africa supports Botswana, among seven countries, in developing a national digital transformation strategy aligned with the AU strategy; it gives no event date, so the survey's October 2024 publication date is used.

systems.owner: Government of Botswana, with UNECA support
systems.tiers: national; being developed, aligned with the AU Digital Transformation Strategy
